tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | AI-Assisted Delivery
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, and OCC REST APIs, with a proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integration and database performance tuning. I bridge the gap between business and IT by translating complex requirements into scalable solutions. Proficient in CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes, I leverage generative AI to accelerate development, documentation, and production troubleshooting in agile, international environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: Your focus on combining AI-competence with engineering excellence aligns perfectly with my background as a SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer. With over 5 years of experience delivering large-scale e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute my expertise in Java, Spring, and headless API integrations to your team.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: I have extensive hands-on experience with SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211, designing and implementing complex backend functionality and OCC REST APIs.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: I bridge business and technical teams by translating requirements into functional specifications and user stories, ensuring seamless PIM/ERP/MDM integration.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Development
bullets.text: I utilize generative AI and LLM tools to accelerate development cycles, documentation, and production troubleshooting, maintaining high code quality.

bullets.label: System Performance
bullets.text: I have a proven track record of optimizing database performance and engineering API migrations to ensure system stability and data consistency.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period, with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can support your projects.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: Ihr Fokus auf die Verbindung von KI-Kompetenz und Engineering-Exzellenz entspricht genau meinem Profil als SAP-zertifizierter Commerce Cloud Developer. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, Spring und Headless-API-Integrationen mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Ich verfüge über umfassende praktische Erfahrung mit SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 und 2211, insbesondere bei der Implementierung von Backend-Funktionalitäten und OCC REST APIs.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT übersetze ich Anforderungen in funktionale Spezifikationen und User Stories, inklusive der Integration von PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Systemen.

bullets.label: KI-gestützte Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich setze generative KI und LLM-Tools gezielt ein, um Entwicklungszyklen, Dokumentationen und die Fehlerbehebung in der Produktion effizient zu beschleunigen.

bullets.label: Systemoptimierung
bullets.text: Durch meine Erfahrung in der Datenbankoptimierung und API-Migrationen stelle ich die Stabilität und Datenkonsistenz in hochverfügbaren E-Commerce-Umgebungen sicher.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 für neue Herausforderungen zur Verfügung stehe. Gerne stelle ich mich Ihnen in einem Gespräch vor.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to your company because of your commitment to combining AI-driven innovation with robust engineering excellence in the SAP Commerce space. Having worked on large-scale enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I value environments that prioritize technical depth and scalable architecture. I am eager to bring my experience in PIM/ERP integration and my proactive approach to AI-assisted delivery to help your team solve complex e-commerce challenges.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am a SAP Certified Developer passionate about building scalable e-commerce solutions. I combine deep Java/Spring expertise with AI-assisted delivery to bridge business needs and technical implementation, ensuring high-performance results for enterprise clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I am a SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I specialize in Java, Spring, and AI-assisted delivery. I am interested in your SAP Commerce role and would love to connect. Best, Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over 5 years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have a strong background in Java, Spring, and OCC REST API integrations. I am confident that my techno-functional expertise and AI-driven development approach will be a great asset to your team. I am available to start from 16 December 2026 and look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
